zh: 组件可以把链接交给宿主打开：`widget.open(url)` 发一条桥消息，由宿主页面在新标签页里开出这一页，协议只限 http 与 https。沙箱仍然不给导航与弹窗，组件拿到的只是「请宿主开一个网页」这一件事；会话里内联显示的卡片同样可用。
en: Widgets can hand a link to the host: `widget.open(url)` sends one bridge message and the host page opens it in a new tab, limited to http and https. The sandbox still grants no navigation or popups — a widget only gets to ask the host to open a page, and inline cards in a session can do it too.
